id: title:Gilbert09:retry pgbouncer connection drop on postgres queue producer connect

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient fault recovery to warehouse queue database connection establishment, preventing pipeline setup stalls without requiring full activity restart.
review.reason: Adds a retry and backoff mechanism for transient Postgres connection failures. This is a substantive, bounded reliability improvement: it prevents transient network or database blips from permanently stalling warehouse queue setup, while avoiding the cost of re-running the entire Temporal activity. The implementation is localized to the connection establishment path.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the observed code change. No independent verification exists that this specific transient failure actually occurred in production or that the retry mechanism successfully recovered without human intervention. The benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than observed outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds retry and backoff for transient Postgres connection failures.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects to warehouse queue database; transient drops could stall pipeline setup. Retry clears a one-off blip without re-running the whole Temporal activity.
